# Vendored Termux terminal libraries

`java/` and `jni/` are the unmodified `terminal-emulator` and `terminal-view`
libraries from [termux/termux-app](https://github.com/termux/termux-app)
v0.118.3 (terminal emulation, rendering, and the pty helper). They derive from
"Terminal Emulator for Android" (Apache License 2.0); termux-app as a whole is
GPLv3. Termant's Android app is distributed under GPLv3 to stay compatible.
